audit.whatIsWrong: Full's phases[].side (Seraphine,Seraphine,Seraphine,Skill,Skill,Taric,Taric) disagreed with content's win[] (Skill,Skill,Skill,Skill,Taric,Skill,Skill) on 5 of 7 rows, while content already matched packet.levelChart exactly.
audit.why: Content's whys/spikes are specific and grounded (E-Q poke edge early, Cosmic Radiance invulnerability at 6, poke swings back even at 1st item, execution-decided late) and match the real per-level win rate data.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0/1/2/4/5/6].side to match content/packet, with why lines restating the grounded reasoning; phases[3] already agreed and was left alone. win[N] needed no edits since content was already correct.

audit.why: Level 2 poke-vs-sustain edge, level 6 Cosmic Radiance invulnerability, and the 1st-item poke swing-back are the real named spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions flagged that Taric sustains through chip damage via Starlight's Touch (Q), but itemization only said "his duo's sustain" without naming the ability.
audit.why: Q's healing is charge-based off Bravado-empowered autos — anti-heal directly answers it.

edits.before: Q-poke the pair and count notes — every third spell sings twice.
edits.after: Even at level 1: your E-Q threat offsets his early sustain, and it comes down to who lands the cleaner poke.

edits.before: W-sustain begins: the duo shield-heal makes even trades dishonest.
edits.after: Your E-Q threat matches his kit here — you carry a slight poke edge while he's melee, but landing it is still on you.

edits.before: E-chains open: slow into root is the lane's longest pick.
edits.after: Level 3 stays even: you out-poke his short-range Bravado trades, but nothing forces the issue outright.

edits.before: Encore online — the charm extends through your team; fights start two screens early.
edits.after: This is his phase: Cosmic Radiance makes his whole side invulnerable, so committing Encore or your ADC's burst into it just wastes the engage — bait it or fight while it's down.

edits.before: First item: echoed Qs chunk and the ledger compounds.
edits.after: First item swings back to even — your double-cast Q and W shields out-poke his short-range Bravado trades, and he has to walk into your E stun range to answer.

edits.before: Late Seraphine conducts teamfights from the support slot — charm, echo, root, repeat.
edits.after: Late it's skill-decided: Cosmic Radiance stays fight-defining, but your range, AoE poke and Encore picks match it if you force fights while his R is down.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - E Beat Drop is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Taric's Cosmic Radiance is down 180s at rank 1, 120s at rank 3 — the delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage, so burst before it lands or wait it out. - Your E Beat Drop cools 11s at rank 1 down to 9s at rank 5 — one root per window.

edits.before: Echoed Q the pair, W the trade-back, E the disengage — taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Save the echo for a stalemate W — the doubled shield-heal outlasts his charge-based Starlight's Touch healing.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W off-rhythm — the third note is the champion.
edits.after: His Dazzle reaches 610, well under your 800-range W — trading inside his stun range for a shield just feeds him the stun.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Helia or Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Helia or Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Starlight's Touch heals off stored charges — anti-heal early cuts it down.
